description: This file defines an interface Zend_Validate_Interface used for validation classes within the Zend Framework, specifying methods like isValid() and getMessages() for validation logic.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Interface
classes.description: An interface that declares validation methods for implementing classes, including isValid() and getMessages().

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Method for validating a value; returns true if the value passes validation, false otherwise.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Method to retrieve messages explaining why validation failed.
